agent.problem: Discovery questions dominate the stop instead of being the exception. Cards 2, 4, 6, 12 and 13 provide no earlier-card basis for reasoning out Joshua, the purpose involving children, life, Moses' death or Aaron, and card 11 likewise asks for the unrevealed name Canaan. That makes at least six of the ten choice cards dependent on guessing a new detail rather than most choices being informed guesses.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.

agent.problem: The Canaan blank tests a place name the baker cannot reason out from the earlier cards. Card 10 only locates Mount Nebo in Moab across from Jericho; no earlier card names Canaan or supplies a way to derive that name, so this blank asks for unseen wording rather than an inferable meaning.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
